name: Dot system
source: A flat brand film built from a single dot: one dot becomes concentric rings, the rings become a grid of dots, the grid is carved into letterforms, the letterforms resolve into the brand mark. Calm, mostly white, perfectly flat, one idea at a time. Described from frames; no files or pixels are carried.

frame_device.what: A single shared unit (a dot, 3 to 10 px at the start) and the invisible lattice it lives on. The lattice shows only as the dots themselves: a grid of identical dots with equal pitch appears whenever the beat needs a field. Frame is white or near white with a lot of empty space; one thing is happening at a time.
frame_device.moves: The dot multiplies and subdivides: it grows rings (0.5 s), the rings step into a grid (0.8 s staggered from the centre), and the grid's dots change size and visibility to draw shapes and letters (0.6 to 0.8 s). The lattice pitch stays constant across beats so each form is a re-sampling of the same field.

type.classes: A single clean sans (regular to medium weight) in sentence case for the line, at a readable mid size, and the dot-matrix letterforms for the hero word built from the grid's dots.
type.behaviour: Lines are short, whole and centred inside the safe area, set in solid type. Dot-matrix words must be dense enough to read at a glance (at least 5 dots per cap height, and a solid-type copy fades in under it for 0.3 s when the word is complete). Nothing is cropped.

image.treatment: No photographs: forms made of dots, rings and lines in one or two ink colours. Real UI or the brand mark arrives as the end state, drawn flat.
image.behaviour: Forms are resamplings: a dot grid shows an image by dot size (halftone) and morphs to another by size changes in place. Nothing slides in from outside; things appear from the dot, and return to it.

transitions: grid to letterforms (dots sized to a mask)
letterforms to the mark (dots migrate to its strokes)
dot scales up until it is the next ground
grid sweep (a wave of size change)

techniques.name: Seed dot
techniques.what: A single dot appears centre-frame and pulses once, the whole film's first idea.
techniques.route: A circle (div or SVG) scale 0 to 1 with back.out(2.4) over 0.35 s, a 4 to 6 px dot at 1080p; a single sine breath scale 1 to 1.1 over 0.5 s.

techniques.name: Ring bloom
techniques.what: Concentric rings spread from the dot, each ring one beat later than the last.
techniques.route: Three to six SVG circles with stroke only, r 0 to R*k, stroke-width 1.5, stagger 0.08 s (0.8 s expo.out); fade the outermost as the next form begins.

techniques.name: Grid fill from the centre
techniques.what: A grid of equal dots fills the frame outward from the centre in a wave.
techniques.route: Create cols x rows dots (about 24x14, pitch 4% of width) as divs or one SVG; gsap.from(dots, {scale: 0, stagger: {grid:[cols,rows], from:'center', amount: 0.9}, ease:'back.out(1.7)'}) in 1 s.

techniques.name: Size wave
techniques.what: A wave of scale runs through the grid, giving the field its breath before it becomes a shape.
techniques.route: Per-dot scale tween yoyo 1 to 1.6 to 1 with stagger grid from 'edges' or a corner, amount 0.8 s, sine.inOut; two cycles.

techniques.name: Letter carve
techniques.what: Dots turn the grid into a word: dots inside the glyph shapes grow and the others shrink to nothing.
techniques.route: Rasterise the text to an offscreen canvas at the grid's resolution to get an in/out mask per dot; tween scale of in-dots to 1 and out-dots to 0 (0.6 s power3.inOut, stagger from the glyph centre 0.3 s); fade in solid type beneath at the end.

techniques.name: Dots migrate to the mark
techniques.what: Each dot travels to a point on the logo's strokes, so the field becomes the mark.
techniques.route: Sample N points along the logo path (SVG getPointAtLength); assign each dot a target by nearest sort; tween x, y (1.0 s power3.inOut, stagger 0.003 s) and scale; extra dots shrink to 0; crossfade to the real SVG mark in the final 0.2 s.

techniques.name: Halftone UI
techniques.what: A real UI screen or image is shown as a dot field whose dots sharpen into the real pixels.
techniques.route: Sample the image luminance into the grid (canvas getImageData) to set dot scale; then fade the image over the dots (0.5 s) while the dots grow to merge; flat films keep the dots one colour.

techniques.name: Dot becomes the ground
techniques.what: The dot scales until it floods the frame, so the next scene's ground is the dot.
techniques.route: Scale 1 to 60 with expo.in over 0.6 s while its colour is the next ground; the next scene's content appears as it completes; no blur.

techniques.name: Dot becomes the input
techniques.what: A dot stretches into a pill that is the product's input field, so the grammar lands on real UI.
techniques.route: Width from the diameter to 520 px, height unchanged, border-radius 999px (0.6 s expo.inOut); placeholder text types in; later the pill's left end stays a dot that blinks as the caret.

techniques.name: Rule from a dot
techniques.what: A dot sprouts a line (a rule, an axis, a path) that carries a label, the way a chart begins.
techniques.route: A line div or SVG path with scale 0 to 1 from the dot (0.5 s power3.out); a label fades at its end; the line's end holds a second dot.

techniques.name: Dot field becomes a rotating dot sphere (Refreshed.)
techniques.what: The flat grid of dots lifts into a sphere of the same dots that turns slowly, each dot a flat disc facing the camera.
techniques.route: Rasan3D: one `InstancedMesh` of `CircleGeometry` discs with `k.material("unlit", { color: ink })` placed on a Fibonacci sphere; each dot lerps from its grid cell (`k.layout` px) to its sphere point over 1.4 s power3.inOut, then rotation about y 0 to 1.4 rad over 3 s power2.inOut; discs face the lens (`k.camera.quaternion`); lens 85 mm, no DOF, no blur, no bloom. Recipe in `references/3d.md` Brand-flat 3D.

techniques.name: The dot sphere collapses into one dot
techniques.what: The turning sphere draws inward in 0.8 s until one dot is left at the centre, which becomes the next beat's dot.
techniques.route: Rasan3D: same `InstancedMesh`; every dot's position multiplied by (1 - expo.in progress) over 0.8 s with scale 1 to 0 except dot 0, which scales up to the seed-dot size; the last frame equals the 2D `seed-dot` first frame (`k.layout`), so the cut to 2D is invisible.

techniques.name: Dot grid ripples in depth
techniques.what: A wave runs across the dot grid in z, dots near the crest nearer the lens and larger, the grid otherwise flat.
techniques.route: Rasan3D: the instanced grid with per-dot z = 0.5 * sin(distance * 3 - 8 * progress) from `pose`, camera at a 20 degree tilt, unlit flat discs, size from perspective only; 2.0 s `sine.inOut`, no glow.

signature: One dot, one idea at a time: the dot becomes rings, a grid, the word, and finally the brand mark, all on the same lattice.

density.note: One transformation about every 1.2 s with a calm hold of 0.4 to 0.6 s between; never two transformations at once.

palette.accent: none or the brand's single accent for the dots
palette.note: A brand palette overrides these; the devices stay. Dots are one colour, flat.

do: Make the dot the only unit and keep the pitch constant
Transform one thing at a time with room around it
Keep dots perfectly round and flat
End on the real brand mark or UI
Use expo and back eases with real overshoot on dots
Let the solid type fade in under the dot-matrix word
dont: Do not add blur, glow or shadows; 3D only in the flat style (matte or unlit dots, even light)
Do not introduce a second shape family
Do not let the dot-matrix word be too coarse to read
Do not crop or scatter dots beyond the safe area at rest
Do not use more than two colours
